headline: Junior Accountant

notes: Passed the Certified Public Accountant Licensure Examination, May 2025
Varsity member, Junior Philippine Institute of Accountants chapter

summary: Newly licensed CPA with a year of experience as a junior accountant at a banana exporter. I prepare journal entries and month-end schedules, keep supplier and customer ledgers up to date in QuickBooks, and help draft the financial statements. I want to deepen my experience in corporate accounting and audit.

projects.name: Cooperative bookkeeping clinic
projects.description: Helped a Tagum vegetable growers' cooperative set up a cash book, simple ledgers and a monthly Excel trial balance, then trained two officers to keep them.

skills: Month-end close and preparation of financial statements

experience.title: Junior Accountant
bullets: Record about 400 supplier invoices a month and prepare the weekly payment run for approval.
Send statements and follow up overdue customer balances, bringing accounts over 60 days down by a fifth.
Prepare bank and intercompany reconciliations and the supporting schedules for the monthly financial statements.
Keep the QuickBooks chart of accounts tidy and document each recurring entry for the next person.

experience.title: Accounting Intern
bullets: Posted daily collections to member ledgers and prepared the cooperative's monthly trial balance.
